mapper.sql: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.publisher, b.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, b.price, b.discount, b.promo_price AS promoPrice, b.promo_start_time AS promoStartTime, b.promo_end_time AS promoEndTime, b.grab_start_time AS grabStartTime, b.stock, b.sales, b.cover_image AS coverImage, b.description, b.status FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
WHERE b.deleted = 0
AND b.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND (b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND b.status = #{status}
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN b.promo_start_time IS NOT NULL AND NOW() BETWEEN b.promo_start_time AND b.promo_end_time THEN b.promo_price ELSE b.price * b.discount END) ASC, b.id DESC
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN b.promo_start_time IS NOT NULL AND NOW() BETWEEN b.promo_start_time AND b.promo_end_time THEN b.promo_price ELSE b.price * b.discount END) DESC, b.id DESC
ORDER BY b.sales DESC, b.id DESC
